source.supplier: Nanjing Ouwei Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. / Anhui Huatian Mechanic Co., Ltd.
source.method: Existing signed-in desktop Chrome → compare five shops → inspect product page and public original-image links → open original in Chrome → native Save. Full-page saves stalled at 97%; direct-image saves completed.
source.imageStatus: Three originally unbranded supplier product images selected. No watermark removal, AI generation, upscaling or pixel editing performed. Supplier provenance remains in this manifest.

workflow: Use the existing normal browser session. Search with the product keyword below.
Open a matching blade product, excluding complete machines and unrelated paper-cutting tools. If sign-in or verification appears, let the user complete it.

Inspect the gallery and description. Open public original-image links in the normal browser and save the individual files. Whole-page saving can remain stuck on unrelated resources; use individual images when that happens.

Confirm the individual image download completed, verify file type and actual pixel dimensions, then inspect its content. Alibaba can serve AVIF despite a URL ending in .png; use the actual file format extension.
Keep raw account-specific snapshots local and ignored by Git. Copy only selected original images to the preview images directory.
Record supplier, canonical product URL, actual pixel dimensions, sharpness check, branding check, decision and specification discrepancies for every candidate.

Compare at least five shops, inspect native image quality and reject branded/watermarked final candidates. Prefer genuinely unbranded original photographs; choose an overview plus complementary edge and mounting views.

Rewrite detail content around application, dimensions, material selection, fit, inspection and packaging questions. Never import another supplier’s certification, delivery time, warranty or test claims.
Build a local preview, verify images and responsive layout. Substitute own or licensed photographs and confirm product specifications before using these as branded product assets.

detailAdditions: Distinguish blade geometry and mounting holes.
Collect sheet material/thickness and upper/lower blade position.

qualityGate.searchCoverage: Compare at least 5 different shops per product; extend the search if no acceptable image is found. This pilot compares Xinerli, Huatian, Alas, SKS/LD and Ouwei.
qualityGate.resolution: Prefer original files with a long edge of at least 1200 px. Files at 960 px may qualify for a 600 px content area after 100% visual inspection. Reject smaller or visibly blurred files. Do not count AI upscaling as recovered detail.
inspection: Inspect the downloaded image dimensions, not the page thumbnail size.
View at 100%: edge continuity, mounting-hole walls, grinding texture, compression blocks and halos.
Check every corner, background and blade face for logos, shop names, watermarks, promotional text and certifications.
Prefer originally unbranded photographs. Mark branded files as rejected for the final selection; if an edit is used, preserve the original and inspect the blade geometry afterward.
Inspect final desktop and mobile display; keep an original and a source record for each selected asset.
A large pixel count alone does not prove a real unretouched photograph. Mark strongly smoothed or rendered-looking views and prefer visible natural machining texture for the main image.
ranking: Correct blade type and credible product detail
